Name: Sheva
Summary: Sheva was scribe in David's later administration, serving beside Zadok, Abiathar, and Ira the Jairite at the time of Sheba's revolt.
KeyStory: Sheva kept the king's records through David's last wars.
RelatedPeople: King David; Zadok, Son of Ahitub; Ira the Jairite
LifeLesson: Late in a reign, the scribes still write it all down.
